dictionary.lore: A simulator Noel found while developing the Frontier Gate. Made in a completely different fashion than anything else in Grand Gaia, its purpose still remains a mystery. However, it was able to gather a lot of demonic energy after Noel upgraded the demon core that serves as its power source. It is said that this transforming device can awaken the latent potential of its wearer.
